system.description:
Cybernetic implant (ancestry). Granted by an ancestry; it is not an item you normally find. Each installed implant gives 1 permanent Trauma (−1 max Hope) unless the Hardwired ancestry exempts it. It is not applied automatically.

Subtle Pheromones: Advantage on rolls to charm or persuade non-hostile creatures.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v2.0 Mind
